notes: Figure(figsize=(width / 96, height / 96)), add_subplot(), axes.plot(x, series) for each series, savefig(StringIO, format='svg'), default settings. Its default path simplification leaves out the points that lie within 1/9 of a pixel of the line through their neighbours, so a series is drawn with 485 to 495 of its 500 points as vertices.
details: matplotlib.figure.Figure is used directly, without pyplot's global state. With the default rcParams['path.simplify'] = True (threshold 1/9 pixel), the five lines of fixture 0 have 485, 495, 486, 495 and 486 vertices. The points left out lie on the line as drawn, which the check accepts; the variant matplotlib-no-simplify turns simplification off and writes every point.
